# Data Ingest

This chapter covers functions that standardize filenames, detect encodings, and normalize tabular data for downstream processing.

## Function: `frdr_filename_check()`

**Purpose:** Enforce a consistent filename policy aligned with FRDR/Alliance guidance (ASCII, no spaces, sensible extensions).

```{r}
#| label: ex-frdr-filename-check
#| message: false
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

candidates <- c("2024 Report.csv", "readme.TXT", "Δelta-data.xlsx", "image.TIFF")
tibble(file = candidates, is_valid = map_lgl(candidates, frdr_filename_check))
```

::: callout-note
**Policy highlights:** Lowercase, hyphen-separated, ASCII only, approved extensions (customizable).\
See `R/functions/frdr_filename_check.R`.
:::

**Purpose:** Heuristically detect likely encodings for text files.

```{r}
#| label: ex-detect-encoding

# (path is a placeholder—replace with your file)
```
